title: Shared card spacing contract
summary: Pages now share one set of spacing rules, so cards and sections sit at a consistent distance from each other. Page sections have slightly more breathing room.
changes: Add shared spacing values for card stacks, grids, and page sections.
Add a stack layout that spaces the cards inside it, for lists of cards.
Give page sections a little more space between them.
Add automated checks for the shared spacing rules.
version_rationale: Minor: first release of the 0.40 card spacing line, adding a new backward-compatible layout capability.
validation: composer pre-pr-verify on the pull request branch.
Local browser check of the public Recruitment page.
known_limitations: Individual pages adopt the new stack layout in the following 0.40 releases.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release package. No database change is involved.
